steps.what: Show the stored claim that may require litigation.
Confer with legal counsel on claims requiring litigation.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the claim file already stored. The claims adjuster confers with legal counsel on whether the claim requires litigation. The file does not hold that conference and does not decide on litigation. A claim with no id leaves the conference with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A claim was marked for litigation because a status line said so, and counsel had not been consulted.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored claim can be opened. The conference with counsel still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A fact the file does not state still has to be discussed with counsel.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster confers with counsel. The file is the record already stored.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays with the adjuster and counsel. The stored file is only visible.

reach.task: Advise on a claim this adjuster brings to the conference.
reach.learn: A status line is not legal advice.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored claim is a lookup. It does not confer with counsel or decide that litigation is required.
A decision to litigate is not made by a screen. Counsel and the adjuster make it in the conference.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The claim id and the file already stored. The screen does not mark the claim as requiring litigation. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the claim file before the conference.
unknowns: Whether litigation flags and ordinary claim notes share one record.
research_questions: Who must be in the conference before a claim is called ready for litigation?

already_counted.description: Conferring with legal counsel stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop claims whose file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still confers with legal counsel on claims that may require litigation. Only opening a claim file that was already stored is removed. A status line saves none of that conference.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show claims already investigated by insurance adjusters.
Examine questionable claims and determine whether to authorize payments.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the investigation already written by an insurance adjuster. The claims adjuster examines the claim, investigates further where it is questionable, and determines whether to authorize payment. The screen does not authorize or deny the payment. Only the decision the adjuster accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A payment was authorized from an investigation title, and the questionable points had not been examined.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored investigation can be opened. The examination and the payment decision still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A doubt the investigation does not mention still has to be examined by the adjuster.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster determines whether to authorize payment. The file is not that decision.
tasks.altitude: The payment decision stays with the adjuster. It is filed only after that version is accepted, and it is not itself a payment.

reach.task: Record a decision this adjuster has accepted.
reach.learn: An investigation title is not an authorization.

evidence.claim: Opening an investigation already written is a lookup. It does not examine the claim or authorize a payment.
Authorizing or denying a payment is a decision with a significant effect on the claimant. The adjuster makes it. A score must not make it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The claim id and the investigation already stored. The authorization is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the investigation. Do not authorize or deny a payment from the screen.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the claims adjuster.
unknowns: Whether every questionable point is already named in the investigation note.
research_questions: Who may accept a payment decision on a claim this adjuster has not examined?

already_counted.description: Examining the claim and determining the payment stay with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop investigations whose claim file has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: claim id and the payment decision the adjuster accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still examines the claim, still investigates what is questionable, and still determines whether to authorize payment. Only opening an investigation that was already written, and filing the decision already accepted, is removed. The screen does not pay or deny.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List settled claims and claims already flagged for analysis.
Maintain claim files requiring detailed analysis.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store lists a claim only when a person has already marked it settled, or has already flagged it as requiring detailed analysis. The screen does not make either mark. The claims adjuster maintains the claim files and accepts the inventory. A claim with neither mark is left for the adjuster. Only the inventory the adjuster accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A claim was marked settled by a list, and no person had settled it.
tasks.enabler_now: Claims already marked can be listed. Maintaining the files, and deciding a mark, still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A file that needs analysis but has no flag still has to be found by the adjuster.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster maintains the files. The list does not settle a claim or assign it for analysis.
tasks.altitude: The maintenance stays with the adjuster. The inventory is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Keep a file this adjuster is maintaining.
reach.learn: A list is not a settlement.

evidence.claim: Listing claims that a person has already marked settled, or already flagged for analysis, is a copy of those marks. It does not maintain the file or make the mark.
Filing an inventory before the adjuster accepts that version would store a settlement or an analysis decision nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The claim id and a settled flag or an analysis flag already stored by a person. A claim with neither mark is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: List only existing marks. Do not mark a claim settled, and do not decide that it needs analysis.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the claims adjuster.
unknowns: Whether settled marks and analysis flags are stored on the same claim record.
research_questions: Who is allowed to set the settled mark or the analysis flag?

already_counted.description: Maintaining the claim files stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop claims whose file has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: claim ids and the marks the adjuster accepted in the inventory

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still maintains the claim files, including records of settled claims and claims that need detailed analysis. Only listing marks a person already made, and filing the inventory already accepted, is removed. The screen does not settle a claim or assign it for analysis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored claim file before any referral.
Refer questionable claims to an investigator or adjuster.
Send the accepted referral for investigation or settlement.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the claim file already stored. The claims adjuster decides that the claim is questionable and refers it to an investigator or another adjuster for investigation or settlement. The screen does not make that referral. Only the referral the adjuster accepts is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: A claim was sent to an investigator because a title looked odd, and the adjuster had not referred it.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored claim can be opened. The decision to refer, and the referral itself, still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A doubt the file does not state still has to be judged by the adjuster before a referral.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster refers the claim. The file is not the referral.
tasks.altitude: The referral stays with the adjuster. It is sent only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Investigate a claim this adjuster has referred.
reach.learn: A claim title is not a referral.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored claim is a lookup. It does not decide that the claim is questionable or refer it.
Sending a referral before the adjuster accepts that version would send a case nobody referred.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The claim id and the file already stored. The referral text is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the claim. Do not send a referral the adjuster has not accepted.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the claims adjuster.
unknowns: Whether investigator and adjuster referrals share one record.
research_questions: Who may receive a referral before the adjuster has named the reason?

already_counted.description: Deciding to refer the claim stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop claims whose file has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: claim id and the referral text the adjuster accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still refers the questionable claim to an investigator or another adjuster for investigation or settlement. Only opening a file that was already stored, and sending the referral already accepted, is removed. A title saves none of that decision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The claims adjuster still confers with counsel, still decides the payment, still maintains the file, and still refers the questionable claim. A stored file can be opened. It does not make those calls.
reach: Counsel hear the claim from this adjuster, and a file title is not the conference.
Investigators receive a referral only after this adjuster has accepted it.
skills_to_grow: Confer with counsel in the conversation, not from a status line.
Authorize a payment only as the adjuster's own decision. The screen does not pay or deny.
List a claim as settled only when a person has already marked it settled.
role.ambitious_version: Counsel, payment decisions, file maintenance, and referrals stay with the adjuster. A stored flag only shows a mark a person already made.
